title: Stone Merging
prompt:
**Problem.** Line 1: n. Line 2: n pile sizes in row order.
Merging two ADJACENT piles costs their total; print the minimum total
cost to end with one pile.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n ≤ 500; 1 ≤ a[i] ≤ 10^6.

Adjacent-only merging forbids the easy greedy — order matters.

tests.name: four piles
three piles
single pile
